P.name: Rock Surfing
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} While near [[terrain]], '''Taliyah''' gains {{sti|ms|{{as|{{pp|10;15;25;40|1;9;12;15|key=%}}|ms}}}} {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}, which builds up over 1 second while in range for at least {{fd|0.4}} seconds, and decays {{tt|at the same rate|See notes}} once out of range for at least 3 seconds.
P.description2: If '''Taliyah''' is casting an {{tip|ability}} or enters [[combat status|champion combat]], ''Rock Surfing'' cannot occur again for a few seconds.

Q.name: Threaded Volley
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taliyah''' barrages 5 ''Stone Shards'' in the target direction over {{fd|1.5}} seconds that each shatter upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. Subsequent hits deal 40% damage.
Q.leveling: {{st|Magic Damage|{{ap|55 to 125}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}|Reduced Damage|{{ap|55*0.4 to 125*0.4}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*0.4}}% AP)}}|Total Magic Damage|{{ap|55*2.6 to 125*2.6}} {{as|(+ 130% AP)}}}}
Q.description2: '''Taliyah''' can move and cast other abilities while launching ''Stone Shards'', and is unable to basic attack until she launches the third ''Stone Shard''.
Q.description3: Casting ''Threaded Volley'' creates an area of {{as|Worked Ground|terrain}} at '''Taliyah's''' cast location that has a radius of 400 units and lasts 30 seconds. While '''Taliyah''' is within an area of {{as|Worked Ground|terrain}}, ''Threaded Volley's'' cast consumes the area to become empowered with a new effect, costing {{sti|{{as|10 mana}}}} and having {{sti|cd|50%}} reduced cooldown, though not below {{fd|0.75}} seconds.
Q.description4: {{sbc|Empowered Active:}} '''Taliyah''' hurls a ''Boulder'' that explodes upon the first enemy hit, dealing {{ccs|180%|magic}} damage to them and normal damage to nearby enemies, {{tip|slow|slowing}} all targets hit for {{fd|1.5}} seconds, and {{tip|standard sight|revealing}} them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds. {{tip|Monsters}} hit are also {{tip|stun|stunned}} for 3 seconds.
Q.leveling4:
{{st|Empowered Damage|{{ap|55*1.8 to 125*1.8}} {{as|(+ {{ap|50*1.8}}% AP)}}|Secondary Target Damage|{{ap|55 to 125}} {{as|(+ 50% AP)}}}}
{{st|Slow|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
Q.description5: Against {{tip|monsters}}, ''Threaded Volley'' deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} per ''Stone Shard'', and the ''Boulder'' from the empowered cast deals 80% '''bonus''' damage against the primary target. This '''bonus''' damage is unaffected by the damage modifier from subsequent hits.
Q.leveling5: {{st|Bonus Monster Damage|{{ap|20 to 40}}|Boulder Bonus Monster Damage|{{ap|20*1.8 to 40*1.8}}}}

W.name: Seismic Shove
W.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taliyah''' marks the target location and selects a direction. After {{tt|{{fd|0.792 seconds}}|Under normal tick interval circumstances, both cast time and 0.5s delay are rounding up}}, a ledge erupts from the area that {{tip|airborne|knocks}} enemies hit 400 units in the target direction over 1 second.

E.name: Unraveled Earth
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taliyah''' scatters a field of 22 stones across the ground in the target direction that deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit while they erupt. The stones then remain for 4 seconds and {{tip|slow}} enemies within the area by 20%.
E.description2: Enemies that {{tip|dash}} or are {{tip|airborne|knocked}} over a stone will detonate it, taking {{as|magic damage}} and becoming {{tip|stun|stunned}} for {{fd|0.75}} seconds, increased to 2 seconds if they are a {{tip|monster}}. The stun is applied once the displacement ends.
E.description3: An enemy can detonate up to 4 stones, but the damage is reduced by {{pp|changedisplay=true|key=%|type=stones detonated|0 to 75 for 4}}. ''Unraveled Earth'' can affect targets only once per cast; the stones will still detonate but not apply their effects.

R.name: Weaver's Wall
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Taliyah''' summons a torrent of spiraling rocks that cascades in the target direction, {{tip|airborne|knocking aside}} champions hit and erecting a wall of [[terrain]] in its wake. The wall lasts for 4 seconds after completion, then slowly disintegrates from its starting point.
R.description2: '''Taliyah''' also {{tip|channels}} for 1 second, during which ''Weaver's Wall'' can be recast and she {{tip|sight|reveals}} herself.
R.description3:
{{sbc|Recast:}} Upon completing the {{tip|channel}}, '''Taliyah''' {{tip|dash|surfs}} on the wall as it emerges, {{tip|sight|revealing}} herself in the process. After {{fd|0.75}} seconds, she may input a movement command to {{tip|dash|jump}} off the wall {{tt|to the target location|Will cast at maximum range (clamped) if ordered location is beyond this jump off command's range}}, and automatically does so upon being {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}} or {{tip|silence|silenced}} or reaching maximum range.

Once the wall has fully formed, '''Taliyah''' can recast to destroy the wall instantly.
R.description4: ''Weaver's Wall'' is placed on a {{sti|cd|3-second}} {{tt|static cooldown|Unaffected by ability haste}} upon taking {{tip|champion}} or {{tip|turret}} damage.
R.cooldown: {{tt|{{ap|180 to 120}}|Starts after wall expires or is destroyed}}
